interpretation: The terminal boundary used by the backward symbolic solver is independently supported by exhaustive physical-game enumeration on four complete variants and by external known terminal fixtures on standard 7x6 geometry.
Every small-game geometric winning-line schema was exercised by at least one actual terminal edge.

There were zero disagreements between mask-based and directional win detection, zero reconstructed terminal-board mismatches, zero admitted post-terminal states, and zero frozen-oracle consistency mismatches.
The standard 7x6 frozen Pons slice happened to contain no immediate terminal actions; this limitation is explicit rather than being treated as coverage it does not provide.
